Section 1: Basic Computer Organisation (Questions 1 to 20)

Q1. What is the primary function of the CPU?

A) To store data permanently B) To execute instructions and process data ✅ C) To display output D) To connect to the internet

Q2. Which of the following is a type of primary memory?

A) Hard Disk B) CD-ROM C) RAM ✅ D) Pen Drive

Q3. What does volatile memory mean?

A) Memory that retains data without power B) Memory that loses data when power is turned off ✅ C) Memory that is very fast D) Memory that is very slow

Q4. Which of the following is an example of non-volatile memory?

A) RAM B) Cache C) ROM ✅ D) Register

Q5. 1 GB is equal to how many bytes?

A) 1024 × 1024 bytes B) 1024 × 1024 × 1024 bytes ✅ C) 1024 bytes D) 1000 × 1000 × 1000 bytes

Q6. Which memory is located closest to the CPU?

A) RAM B) Cache Memory ✅ C) Hard Disk D) ROM

Q7. Which of the following is NOT an input device?

A) Scanner B) Mouse C) Plotter ✅ D) Microphone

Q8. Which of the following is NOT an output device?

A) Monitor B) Printer C) Speaker D) Scanner ✅

Q9. What is the full form of MBR in computer architecture?

A) Memory Buffer Register ✅ B) Main Buffer Register C) Memory Byte Register D) Main Byte Register

Q10. Which register holds the address of the next instruction to be executed?

A) Accumulator B) Program Counter ✅ C) Instruction Register D) Memory Address Register

Q11. 1 Terabyte (TB) is equal to how many Gigabytes?

A) 1000 GB B) 1024 GB ✅ C) 1024 MB D) 1000 MB

Q12. Which of the following is a combination of input and output device?

A) Keyboard B) Mouse C) Touchscreen ✅ D) Printer

Q13. What is the function of a SMPS (Switched Mode Power Supply)?

A) Provides power to computer components ✅ B) Stores data C) Displays graphics D) Processes data

Q14. Which of the following memories has the highest speed?

A) RAM B) Hard Disk C) Cache Memory ✅ D) Optical Disk

Q15. What is the capacity of a typical DVD?

A) 700 MB B) 4.7 GB ✅ C) 25 GB D) 128 GB

Q16. Which port is used to connect a printer?

A) USB ✅ B) HDMI C) VGA D) RJ45

Q17. What is the function of a graphics card?

A) To process and display graphics ✅ B) To store data C) To connect to the internet D) To process text

Q18. Which of the following is a type of secondary storage?

A) RAM B) ROM C) Hard Disk ✅ D) Cache

Q19. What is the difference between SRAM and DRAM?

A) SRAM is slower than DRAM B) SRAM is faster and more expensive than DRAM ✅ C) DRAM does not need refreshing D) Both are same

Q20. Which component of the CPU performs logical comparisons?

A) CU B) ALU ✅ C) MU D) Register

Q26. IBM 370 is an example of:

Section 3: Concepts of Software (Questions 31 to 55)

Q31. Which of the following is the most essential system software?

A) Word Processor B) Operating System ✅ C) Database Software D) Graphics Software

Q32. What is a device driver?

A) A type of hardware B) A program that controls a device ✅ C) A type of memory D) A programming language

Q33. Which of the following is a programming language translator?

A) Loader B) Linker C) Compiler ✅ D) Operating System

Q34. What is the function of an assembler?

A) Converts high-level language to machine code B) Converts assembly language to machine code ✅ C) Converts machine code to assembly D) Executes programs

Q35. Which of the following is NOT a type of translator?

A) Compiler B) Interpreter C) Assembler D) Linker ✅

Q36. What is the difference between multiprogramming and multiprocessing?

A) Multiprogramming uses multiple CPUs, multiprocessing uses one CPU B) Multiprogramming uses one CPU for multiple programs, multiprocessing uses multiple CPUs ✅ C) Both are same D) Multiprocessing is slower

Q37. Which type of OS is used in ATMs?

A) Batch OS B) Time-sharing OS C) Real-time OS ✅ D) Multiprogramming

Q38. Which Linux command is used to list files in long format?

A) ls -l ✅ B) ls -a C) ls -r D) ls -t

Q39. Which Linux command shows hidden files?

A) ls -a ✅ B) ls -l C) ls -r D) ls -t

Q40. Which Linux command is used to check disk usage?

A) du ✅ B) df C) disk D) size

Q41. Which Linux command displays the calendar?

A) date B) cal ✅ C) year D) time

A) To help users write programs B) To maintain and optimize the computer system ✅ C) To create documents D) To browse the internet

Q44. Which of the following is NOT a type of utility software?

A) Antivirus B) Disk Defragmenter C) File Manager D) Word Processor ✅

Q45. What is the full form of GUI?

A) Graphics User Interface B) Graphical User Interface ✅ C) Graphic Utility Interface D) General User Interface

Q46. Which of the following is a CUI operating system?

A) Windows 10 B) macOS C) Linux Terminal / UNIX shell ✅ D) Android

Q47. Which Linux command is used to change file permissions?

A) chmod ✅ B) chown C) change D) perm

Q48. Which Linux command is used to change the owner of a file?

A) chmod B) chown ✅ C) change D) owner

A) Google Chrome B) Adobe Photoshop C) macOS ✅ D) Microsoft Office

Q50. Which of the following is an example of application software?

A) Windows 10 B) Ubuntu C) MS Access ✅ D) BIOS

Q51. What is the role of BIOS in a computer?

A) To compile programs B) To initialize hardware and boot the system ✅ C) To create documents D) To browse the internet

Q52. Which of the following is a single-user, single-tasking OS?

A) Windows 10 B) MS-DOS ✅ C) Linux D) macOS

Q53. Which of the following is a multi-user, multi-tasking OS?

A) MS-DOS B) Windows 10 (professional) / Linux ✅ C) Windows 3.1 D) CP/M

Q54. What is the function of the operating system's file management?

A) To create files B) To organize, store, and retrieve files ✅ C) To delete files only D) To rename files

Q55. Which of the following is NOT a type of software?

Actually, firmware is a type of software. Let's change: Q55. Which of the following is NOT a characteristic of system software? A) It manages hardware B) It provides a platform for application software C) It is user-specific ✅ D) It is essential for computer operation

Section 4: Number System (Questions 56 to 80)

Q56. What is the binary equivalent of decimal 255?

A) 11111111 ✅ B) 10000000 C) 11111110 D) 10101010

Q57. What is the binary equivalent of decimal 128?

A) 11111111 B) 10000000 ✅ C) 01111111 D) 10000001

Q58. What is the octal equivalent of decimal 64?

A) 100 ✅ B) 80 C) 77 D) 70

Q59. What is the hexadecimal equivalent of decimal 100?

A) 64 ✅ B) 100 C) 70 D) 65

Q60. What is the decimal equivalent of binary 11111111?

A) 255 ✅ B) 127 C) 128 D) 256

Q61. What is the decimal equivalent of octal 100?

A) 64 ✅ B) 100 C) 80 D) 70

Q62. What is the decimal equivalent of hexadecimal FF?

A) 255 ✅ B) 256 C) 128 D) 240

Q63. What is the binary equivalent of octal 20?

A) 10000 ✅ B) 10100 C) 11000 D) 10010

Q64. What is the octal equivalent of binary 100000?

A) 40 ✅ B) 30 C) 50 D) 20

Q65. What is the binary equivalent of hexadecimal F0?

A) 11110000 ✅ B) 11100000 C) 11000000 D) 10100000

Q66. What is the hexadecimal equivalent of binary 11110000?

A) F0 ✅ B) 0F C) E0 D) F1

Q67. What is the 8421 code for decimal 6?

A) 0110 ✅ B) 0101 C) 1000 D) 0011

Q68. What is the Excess-3 code for decimal 2?

A) 0101 ✅ (2 + 3 = 5 → 0101) B) 0010 C) 0110 D) 0100

Q69. What is the BCD code for decimal 25?

A) 0010 0101 ✅ B) 0010 1000 C) 0001 1001 D) 0011 0001

Q70. What is the Grey code for binary 1100?

A) 1010 ✅ (1100 → 1010) B) 1001 C) 1110 D) 1101

Q71. What is the binary for Grey code 1010?

A) 1100 ✅ B) 1001 C) 1110 D) 1011

Q72. How many bits are there in Unicode?

A) 8 B) 16 C) 32 D) Both B and C (UTF-16 and UTF-32) ✅

Q73. Which of the following is a character encoding scheme?

A) ASCII B) ISCII C) Unicode D) All of the above ✅

Q74. What is the 1's complement of binary 1110?

A) 0001 ✅ B) 1110 C) 1000 D) 0111

Q75. What is the 2's complement of binary 1110?

A) 0001 B) 0010 ✅ (1's complement 0001 + 1 = 0010) C) 1111 D) 0000

Q76. What is the decimal value of 4-bit 2's complement 1000?

A) -8 ✅ B) 8 C) -7 D) 7

Q77. What is the decimal value of 4-bit 2's complement 0111?

A) 7 ✅ B) -7 C) 8 D) -8

Q78. Convert decimal -1 to binary (4-bit 2's complement).

A) 1111 ✅ B) 1000 C) 0001 D) 1110

Q79. Convert decimal -7 to binary (4-bit 2's complement).

A) 1001 ✅ (-7 = 0111 → 1000 + 1 = 1001) B) 1000 C) 1010 D) 1111

Q80. Which is the most popular encoding scheme for web pages?

A) ASCII B) ISCII C) Unicode ✅ D) BCD
